openings.claim: Direct edge bearing may restrain sideways sliding without corner pressure lifting the opposite corner. Replace seal-friction reliance with two opposed paired-strip clamps: lower jaws under accessible rim lips, padded upper jaws over hatch, external closing bolts, and lateral abutments against hatch and rim. Cord-tether assemblies; lift completely clear for inspection.
openings.discriminator: Against padded friction-only clamps, engaged abutments should arrest travel before 1 mm with modest preload. If both arrangements require increased corner pressure and produce the same opposite-corner lift, separation of shear restraint from closure pressure fails.
openings.probe: Check lip access, bolt clearance, protective-pad coverage, abutment contact and full removal using ruler and loose strips; fabricate only if compatible. Use four strips, four pads and at most six bolts; drill only strips. Mark centered hatch; run ten opening/closure/20 N pull cycles, tenth with right-contact 1 mm card. Measure displacement and opposite-corner lift, time each reopening, inspect seal. Stop for damage or insecure engagement. Uses one configuration, ten of twelve trials; untreated-slide evidence supplies only a limited rival reference.
openings.uncertainty: Accessible underside/edges must permit removable direct-bearing jaws without hatch/rim machining. Strip stiffness, bolt lengths and pad placement must enable secure engagement within 90-minute fabrication and 20-minute observation limits. Card-induced disengagement or unacceptable rocking requires testing. Geometry and hardware capacity are unproven; trial capacity assures neither fabrication nor performance.

lineage.reason: Preserves mechanism, rival, defeat prediction, probe, assumptions, stopping/resource caveats and declared uncertain fit; no protected item omitted.

decision: Probe candidate only. Defeat: incompatible geometry, inadequate hardware, new seal tears, displacement above 1 mm, failure to withstand 20 N, or reopening above 30 seconds after ten cycles. Preserve hatch/rim/seal: no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation; opening fully unobstructed; no power; loose parts recoverable. Disturbance waives seal-contact continuity only. Friction-only rival comparison remains limited.
